answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks using periodic proof-of-work challenges. Agents must solve sequential cryptographic puzzles to remain active, forcing attackers to incur scarce processor cycles and electricity per alias, pushing mass forgery over an economic ledge. Relays verify these proofs to grant a violet tier of network priority, discarding peers whose heartbeat cools to an ember. However, this mechanism consumes significant energy and penalizes resource-constrained devices.
